data.name: MoveCloserToUsage_KeywordDescription
data.value: The keyword of the declaration in the procedure.

data.name: MoveCloserToUsage_Static
data.value: Static: it keeps its value from one call to the next

data.name: MoveCloserToUsage_Dim
data.value: Dim: it is initialized at each call

data.name: MoveCloserToUsage_NotAVariable
data.value: Nothing here is a variable whose declaration can be moved.

data.name: MoveCloserToUsage_NotPrivate
data.value: '{0}' can be used by other modules: only a Private variable of a module is moved into a procedure.

data.name: MoveCloserToUsage_WithEvents
data.value: '{0}' is declared WithEvents, which a procedure cannot declare.

data.name: MoveCloserToUsage_SeveralProcedures
data.value: '{0}' is used by more than one procedure ({1}), or outside a procedure.

data.name: MoveCloserToUsage_Conditional
data.value: '{0}' is declared, or first used, in a branch of an #If block.

data.name: MoveCloserToUsage_AlreadyClose
data.value: '{0}' is already declared before the statement that first uses it.

data.name: MoveCloserToUsage_SharesItsLine
data.value: '{0}' is declared by a statement that shares its line with another statement.

data.name: MoveCloserToUsage_NotKept
data.value: '{0}' keeps its value between calls: declared with Dim in '{1}', it is initialized at each call.
